page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor and built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The processor is an Intel Xeon 8269CY. This configuration provides a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores, meaning hyperthreading is not enabled, resulting in 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators. From a resource density perspective, the dedicated core allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this server as a stable resource pool for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading.

The ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is suitable for multi-threaded applications, general-purpose enterprise workloads, web serving, and application servers that benefit from dedicated physical cores and a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio. The lack of local storage and GPUs makes it less suitable for intensive local database caching or deep learning workloads, but it is appropriate for distributed computing, application hosting, and general-purpose business logic.
